title: Local cleared fractions for twist sections on a Proj chart
statement: Let $A=\bigoplus_{d\ge0}A_d$ be an $\mathbf N$-graded commutative ring, $f\in A_b$ with $b>0$, and $k\in\mathbf Z$. Let $s$ be a section of $\mathcal O(k)$ on $D_+(f)$ [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf], and put $B=A_{(f)}$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero]. For every $x\in\operatorname{Spec}B$ there exist $g\in B$ and $z\in A_f$ such that $x\in D(g)$ and, for every $p\in D_+(f)$, if $F_p(g)$ is a unit then $F_p(g)s(p)=F_p(z)$ in $A_p$. Here $D(g)=\{q:g\notin q\}$, $A_p$ is localization at the complement of the homogeneous prime underlying $p$, and $F_p:A_f\to A_p$ is the canonical localization map; on $g$, the notation $F_p(g)$ includes the inclusion $B\to A_f$.

source.place: Section Proj of a graded ring, Lemma 01M4 (lemma-standard-open) (1)(f), and the local fraction/stalk construction before Definition 01M6; Lemma 01M7 (lemma-proj-sheaves) for the shift A(k).

proof.text: Use the canonical affine chart D₊(f) ≅ Spec B [prop-nagata-proj-standard-open] to lift x to y in D₊(f). In Lean, ProjIsoSpecTopComponent.toSpec_surjective (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/ProjectiveSpectrum/Scheme.lean:518) supplies y. Unpack the locally homogeneous-fraction predicate of twist to find an open V containing y and homogeneous a,d with s=a/d on V.

By the basic-open basis choose y∈D(u)⊆V; decompose u and choose a homogeneous component u_l avoiding y. The component open D(u_l) is contained in D(u), by the homogeneous-component union formula. Thus D(u_l)⊆V.

Set h=d*u_l*f, c=deg(d)+l+b, N=a*u_l*f, g=h^b/f^c∈B, and z=h^(b-1)*N/f^c∈A_f. Multiplicativity of the grading makes g degree zero. The canonical chart prime contains g iff the homogeneous prime contains h^b: this is its defining numerator criterion (Mathlib ProjIsoSpecTopComponent.ToSpec.mk_mem_carrier, Scheme.lean:179). Since d,u_l,f all avoid y, h^b avoids y, so x∈D(g).

For p where F_p(g) is a unit, the prime-localization unit criterion says h^b avoids p, hence h avoids p since b>0. In particular u_l avoids p and p∈V. The section at p is a/d. The canonical map sends g to h^b/f^c and z to h^(b-1)*N/f^c. Multiplying fractions, cross-multiplication reduces the desired identity to h^b*a=h^(b-1)*N*d. Use h^b=h^(b-1)*h and h=d*u_l*f, N=a*u_l*f to verify this identity by commutative ring arithmetic. The prime-localization criterion is IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_mk'_iff; the cross-multiplication is Localization.r_iff_exists with multiplier 1. No nonzero-numerator or positive-twist assumption is needed.

theorem twist_local_clearing
    {A σ : Type v} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (k : ℤ) (f : A) (b : ℕ)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 b)
    (s : (twist 𝒜 k).val.obj (op (basicOpen 𝒜 f)))
    (x : PrimeSpectrum (HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f)) :
    ∃ (g : HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f) (z : Localization.Away f),
      x ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g ∧
      ∀ p : basicOpen 𝒜 f,
        let F := IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers f)
          (T := p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.primeCompl)
          (Localization.AtPrime p.1.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) (RingHom.id A)
          (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr p.2)
        IsUnit (F (algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f)
          (Localization.Away f) g)) →
        F (algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f)
          (Localization.Away f) g) * (s.1 p).1 = F z
